summary: Short, steep kerb with homes 12-18 m away on its own side.
reasons: Houses 12-18 m away on same side
Steep: about 9% down to the north

best_section.where: Rankin Street west kerb, just north of the corner

drivers.seclusion: Homes 18 m (at 3 m), 16 m and 12 m (at 26 m) on the west side; bush across the road on the east.
drivers.access_and_room: Public street; a few cars park on the east side, west kerb lane is clear and wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street near a corner; low traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 9am-5pm signs; no overnight limit on the signs, and cars park nearby.

flags: Homes within 25 m on the section's own side
Witton Creek 145 m away; ground 26-29 m above sea level
sun_shade: Open to the sky; bush across the road shades the east side in the afternoon.
